name: 到期管家
description: Track due dates and Apple Reminders with custom recurrence intervals, per-item advance action dates, and readable system-language widgets.

localizedDescriptions.en: 2.4.1 gives the recurrence interval and advance-days number fields persistent visible labels, and shows a day, week, month, or year unit beside the interval according to the selected recurrence. Existing items, recurrence behavior, advance action dates, and schema v3 storage remain unchanged.
localizedDescriptions.zh: 2.4.1 为周期间隔和提前天数的数字输入行增加始终可见的名称，并根据所选周期在间隔值旁显示天、周、月或年单位。已有事项、周期规则、提前行动日与 schema v3 存储均保持不变。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 2.4.1 为周期间隔和提前天数的数字输入行增加始终可见的名称，并根据所选周期在间隔值旁显示天、周、月或年单位。已有事项、周期规则、提前行动日与 schema v3 存储均保持不变。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hant: 2.4.1 為週期間隔和提前天數的數字輸入列增加始終可見的名稱，並根據所選週期在間隔值旁顯示天、週、月或年單位。現有事項、週期規則、提前行動日與 schema v3 儲存均保持不變。
